changes: Extend trace storage to 8 GiB on physical Delta only, with at most 4096 requests.
Log every request start, including after capture stops. Latch capture closed after first quota or write failure so retained files are always a prefix.
Add original ordinal to successful result logs.
Explicit diagnostic worker duration via NR_RENDER_STREAM_SECONDS, range 60 to 1800 seconds, default 600.
reason: v115 outlives the initial 512 MiB trace budget. Longer interaction experiments require more recorded state and an explicit finite worker duration.
additional_renderer_changes: Includes pending v224 partial uniform batch fix; desktop use requires full v224 CPU and NPU qualification.
